answer: Agents bind a ferrous stake to each identity, deposited into a haven. Re-execution by peers checks receipts against a reef of previous proofs. Fake identities require fresh stake bonds, as each new one must wait in a cooldown queue with unique timers. The cost: tangible resource waste per ID, scaling linearly with fakes—no parallel farming allowed. Each forged identity burns up-front stake and time, unamortized.
